name: Rieter R35
description: High performance Sulzer  weaving machine engineered for heavy-duty industrial textile production. The Rieter R35 delivers consistent fabric quality at high speeds, with robust construction designed for continuous multi-shift operation. Ideal for mills producing wide width fabrics, this machine combines precision engineering with energy efficient operation to reduce per-meter production costs.

name: AIR-JET L5300
description: The AIR-JET L5300 is a high-speed air-jet weaving machine designed for efficient, high-volume fabric production. Utilizing advanced air-jet insertion technology, it delivers superior weaving speed and precision while minimizing yarn breakage. Built for demanding industrial environments, it's ideal for mills producing lightweight to medium-weight fabrics at scale.
features: Suitable for lightweight to medium-weight fabrics

name: Sulzer S500
description: The Sulzer S500 is a rugged projectile weaving machine built for heavy-duty industrial fabric production. Renowned for its reliability and versatility, it efficiently handles a wide range of yarn types and fabric widths, making it a trusted choice for mills producing technical textiles, denim, and other heavy fabrics. Its robust projectile insertion system ensures consistent quality even under continuous, high-volume operation.
features: Handles wide range of yarn types
Consistent fabric quality at high volumes
